note_on_quantum: This is a FAST MVP MODE cycle. The lane question's binding item (1) is EXIT-0 DISCIPLINE: the blocker's failure mode is LEX_WORK_QUANTUM_EXPIRED at ~2700 s AFTER a complete durable delta, which leaves the tree ungated because the audit job is needs.team == success. This cycle therefore freezes a SMALL hypothesis, runs ONE instrument once, commits, writes state and stops. No second sweep, no readiness-record regeneration loop, no 174k rerun.
question: On the SHIPPED product bundles (rebuilt-39027045675), are the contrary/limiting authorities structurally discoverable, is the cluster panel complete, and is the retrieved population multilingual - or does the shipped map conceal what the answer relies on?
why_this_question_is_not_a_re_run: The accepted instrument named evaluation/benchmark_retrieval_counter_authority.py does NOT answer it: all three of its legs shell out to evaluation.frozen_bars.run_bar_gates and re-score the frozen LABEL and GEOMETRY regression bars. It never measures retrieval or counter-authority exposure. It is left byte-unchanged.
The closed universal-174k suite is NOT rerun and NOT touched.
The frozen reality benchmark (ff57f556) and the CLOSED BJR leg are NOT rerun.

The claim of record for provenance/source falsifiers stays results/evaluation/served_bundle_scope/39086856920.json; this cycle re-runs that accepted instrument only as a reproducibility cross-check and cites the accepted record.

population_frozen.sampling: ALL bundles of the packet. No subsampling, no selection, no exclusion. No decision is dropped.

metrics_frozen.F1 map::unclustered_point_mass: count + share of decisions with unclustered==true OR cluster_id not in the bundle's own declared clusters[] id set
metrics_frozen.F2 map::cluster_panel_coverage: set relation between union(clusters[*].member_ids) and set(decisions[*].decision_id); BOTH differences computed; fires if either is non-empty
metrics_frozen.F3 map::cluster_size_member_len_divergen: per-cluster |size - len(member_ids)|; PUBLISHED ONLY, never a bar, explicitly NOT a re-raise of the accepted-closed item
metrics_frozen.F4 multilingual::language_unassigned: count + share of decisions with empty/absent language, and the overlap with F1
metrics_frozen.F5 counter::emitted_label_placement: cluster placement / outlier flag / unclustered of the classifier-EMITTED adversarial rows; fires when every emitted row is unclustered or none is marked outlier
metrics_frozen.F6 counter::issued_population_reconcilia: SET RELATION between shipped counter_status populations and the ACCEPTED label_lineage_gate verdict of record; published, never a bar

success_rule_frozen.exit_0_BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION: frozen pins all re-hash AND packet.json matches the direction pin AND every falsifier count is zero on every bundle
success_rule_frozen.exit_1_PRODUCT_FALSIFIED: frozen pins all re-hash AND packet.json matches the direction pin AND at least one falsifier fires on the shipped bytes
success_rule_frozen.exit_2_ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS: a pin fails to re-hash, OR packet.json sha differs from the pin, OR a bundle is unmeasurable, OR any non-vacuity control fails to move. NEVER a product pass.

non_vacuity_rule_frozen: Each of F1..F5 is paired with a hostile in-memory mutation of the shipped bytes. A falsifier whose control does not move its quantity is VACUOUS and forces exit 2. A benchmark that cannot fail is not evidence. This rule is frozen before execution and cannot be relaxed after seeing counts.
set_relation_discipline: No two counted sets are compared by matching cardinality. Every set statement is accompanied by its two differences, per factory-wide requirement 16.
instrument_reuse_frozen: evaluation.served_bundle_scope.measure_bundle (accepted; run only as a reproducibility cross-check against the accepted record 39086856920)
no_new_thresholds: Zero thresholds, bars, rubrics or predicates are introduced. Every falsifier fires on a non-zero COUNT or on a SET RELATION that is not identity, which is the convention evaluation.served_bundle_scope already uses. Nothing here can be used to claim any frozen bar is met or unmet.
what_would_change_a_product_decision: A fired F1 means over a fifth of the shipped map carries no cluster, which bears directly on the master prompt's 'counter-authorities are visually discoverable' and on human-gate question 1. A fired F2/F3 means the cluster panel cannot reproduce the clustered set. A fired F5 means the emitted contrary/limiting rows have no structural handle. These are Product-backlog items, not a stop decision.
explicit_non_claims: Does NOT score, move, re-derive or re-tune any frozen bar.
Does NOT re-measure either closed Frontier candidate.
Does NOT say anything about jurist usefulness; human_gate_ready stays false.
Does NOT relax the standing accepted DO-NOT-SERVE orders on any packet.
Does NOT assert unconditional cross-machine byte identity of any rebuild; no rebuild is performed here.
change_policy: If any metric, population, pin, success rule or non-vacuity rule changes after the first execution, this file is RETIRED, the run is reported as an exploratory probe, and a NEW hypothesis with a NEW digest is frozen before any second execution. Nothing is edited in place after observation.
